title: Non-wood dissolving pulp from Hibiscus rosasinensis for sustainable viscose fibre production
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,25582-25595
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA02612E, Paper
Open Access

Sharad P. Pawar, Suyash R. Bhoir, Rupesh A. Khare, Shashank T. Mhaske
Hibiscus stem waste is transformed into high-purity dissolving pulp via PHK processing, yielding regenerated cellulose fibres with textile properties comparable to wood-derived viscose, advancing sustainable bioeconomy pathways.
